title: My SCI FI Space Action Adventure inspired by Sundog, FTL, Star Control and many others.
author: Dapper-Finding-1875
selftext:
![img](jo0zxlal1p3i1)

Solo dev here, building the game I have wanted to play since 1985.

**Moon Punk: Cryorunner i**s my SunDog-inspired 2D space RPG, free in the browser. Your uncle leaves you a freighter, a hold of cryo pods, and his debts. You walk your ship and crew its stations, dogfight pirates, board derelicts and enemy ships, repel boarders deck by deck, and trade across a dozen star systems to pay what he owed. On foot there are towns, contracts, and open country to fight through. FTL is in its DNA, and up to four friends can crew one ship from their own browsers.

It is early alpha and I am tuning whether the ship feels like a place you live in and the balance between vastness and interesting things to keep the player occupied including but not limited to combat, trade, and ship management.  . If you play it, that feedback is what I need most.

**Play free, no download:** [https://smilebytestudios.itch.io/moon-punk](https://l.meta.ai/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fsmilebytestudios.itch.io%2Fmoon-punk&h=AUAs1BnJziuecMVIqaZu1DvItohgXT1ggrVulXDGk6uLHQCbjWVQmlm4KJs3LLNpnjV10i4wAlcq2tHVrrvN4cAwmspycQG6833IL5nOz3x_0jdREbSTig)  
**Trailer**: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NatAtjHNwdc](https://l.meta.ai/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3DNatAtjHNwdc&h=AUAs1BnJziuecMVIqaZu1DvItohgXT1ggrVulXDGk6uLHQCbjWVQmlm4KJs3LLNpnjV10i4wAlcq2tHVrrvN4cAwmspycQG6833IL5nOz3x_0jdREbSTig)

comments.body: u/Dapper-Finding-1875 please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: Dapper-Finding-1875
comments.body: AI was used for part of image generation based on more traditional graphics development I did for precursor concepts over the last 14 years of learning game development and creating some of my own assets.  AI was used to both accelerate code refactoring from older projects over the same time period and add new systems and event generation, with LLMs learning the context of those projects and rapidly helping to system test their interactions.  This is the exact vision I had in 2012 but it would have been impossible to finish as one person.  Most of the music is my own but there are some simpler AI generated tunes for travel Ambience.
